entries.german:
Wir Heinrich, von gots gnaden des heilgin stûles zû
Mentze ertzebischof, des heilgin romischen riches in dutschen
landen ertzecanceler, dun kunt allen luten vnd bekennen vffinlich an
diesem brieue, daz wir vmb vnser vnd vnsers stiftes vnd des lan-
des noit gemeinlich beste eindrechtig worden sin vnd vns virbunden
han vnd virbinden vns an diesem brieue zû dem erwirdigen herren
hern Otten bischof zû Wirtzburg, vnd er sich wieder zû vns.
vier jar die aller nehst komment die itzunt angent als her nach
von worte zû worte geschribin stet.
Des ersten so sollen wir yme beholfin sin wieder aller men-
lichen der gewalt odir vnrecht an yn sinen stift odir sine vndir-
tanen legin wûlte.
Vnd were daz is noit geschee daz er vns manete vmb helfe,
so sollen wir yme beholfin sin nach dem daz er vns odir vnsern
vitzdum zû Aschaffinburg manet nah der manunge innewendig
vierzehen tagin zû tagelichem criege mit funfzig mannen wol irzûgit
mit helmen vff sine kost vnd vnsern schaden vnd virlust. Were
abir daz noit geschee vnd er vns manete als vorgeschribin ist,
so sollen wir yme mit vnser macht beholfin sin ane geuerde vff
sine kost vnd vnsern schaden vnd virlust als vorgeschribin stet.
Vnd were daz vnser beider lute frummen nemen mit einander
an gevangen, den frûmen sal man teilen nah manne zal der lute
die vnsir ieglicher zû der zyt da bi gehabit hette. Brantschatzunge
sollen wir glich teilen. Alle vehe, ane phert, sal yme zû staden
kommen zû der koste. Were auch daz wir odir vnser gesinde ane
die sinen in dem criege frummen nemen an gevangen pherden odir
an reisiger habe, der sal vnser besundern sin.
Gewunnen wir die heine sloz odir vestenunge mit einander
odir besundern in dem criege, die von yme odir vns zû lehen rûr-
ten, die sollent vndir vns des sin von dem sie zû lehene rurent.
Enrurten sie abir von vnserm kheime, so sulten wir sie brechen,
odir andirs da mide tûn, als wir dan bede mit einander zû rate werden.
Zû blyden vnd andern werken der wir darzû bedurfen sollen
wir gemeinliche kost tûn ane geverde.
Vz dieser virbuntnisse nemen wir vz den stûl von Rome,
vnd daz romische riche. Vort nemen wir vz alle vnser suf-
fraganien, vnser manne burgmanne dienstmanne vnd bvrger,
vnd alle die zû den wir vor virbunden sin zû irme rechten.
Were ouch daz wir yme binnen einem mande nach dem daz
er daz an vns brechte von den die wir da vor vzgenomen han
nicht rechtes gehelfin enmochten, so solden wir yme dar nah binnen
viertzehen tagen, ob wir odir vnser amptman gemanet wurden, helfen
wieder den der yme rechtes vzgienge glicher wijs als einen an-
dern als vor geschriebin ist.
Vnd vmb daz alle diese virbuntnisse stûcke vnd artikele als
sie hie vor vnd nah geschriebin stent von vns iewedirsijt veste
vnd stede vnd gantze liebe, vnd fruntschaf vnder vns vnd den vn-
sern virliben, vnd alle vffloufe vnd geschiechte vnd zweiunge die
geschen vnd vffstan mochten virhalten vnd hiengeleget werden, so
han wir den strengen ritter Ebirharten von Rosenberg vnsern
vogd zû Durne odir wer zû den zijten vnser amptman zû
Durne were vûr vns, vnd der vorgenante herre von Wirtze-
burg Conraden Jemerer ritter sinen amptman zû Hohenburg
odir wer zû zijten al da zû Hohenburg amptman ist vur sich zû
ratluten, vnd wir bede mit einander den edeln man Rodolph gra-
uen von Wertheim zû eime gemeinen obirmanne gekorn, also
welchem vnder vns oder den vnsern die wir bede zû virantwertene
hetten kein obirgrif odir schade gesche, der mag vnd sal daz zû-
hant an bede die vorgenanten vnser ratlute brengen, vnd sollent
die selben ratlute binnen achtagen dar nah die clage an sie bracht
wirt zû Wertheim in die stad riden, vnd nummer danne kommen
sie enhaben den clagen ende gegebin mit minnen mit der beider
partyen wizzen vnd willen, odir mit dem rechten ane yren wizzen
vnd willen. Vnd wes sie alsus vur ein reht vff yren eyt eindrechtig
werdent vnd sprechent vnd mit yren vffen besiegelten brieuen be-
schriebin gebent, daz sollent die partyen iewedirsijt stede halten.
Were ouch daz sie zweiende wurden an dem rechten. so solde yr
ieglicher sin sprechen mit sinen vffenen besiegelten brieuen deme
greuen von Wertheim beschriebin gebin. Vnd welcher sin sp[r]echen
alsus beschriebin gibt, der mag danne riten. Vnd waz dan der von
Wertheim dar vbir sprichet, vnd welchers sprechen er bestendig
ist, vnd ouch dar vbir sine brieue gibt, daz sal machte han, vnd sal
man daz stete halten. Vnd hant des die vorgenanten vnser beider
amptlute globt vnd zû den heiligin gesworn, vnd sollent ouch die
die nah yn amptlute werdent daz globen vnd sweren, wanne clage
alsus an sie bracht werdent, zû Wertheim zû ridene. vnd den
clagin einer nah der andern nah dem daz sie an sie bracht werdent
ende zû gebene, ane alle geuerde, als hie vor vnd nach ge-
schriebin ist.
Were ouch daz der vorgenante gref von Wertheim abe
gienge, odir nit bi diesen stucken gesin mochte, so sollent die vor-
genanten vnser ratlute, wanne sie von vns odir vnser eime gemant
werdent, zûhant zû Wertheim riten, odir sint sie da al da bliben,
vnd nummer danne kommen sie ensin eines andern obirmannes der
vns beiden genûngeclich sij ane geverde eindrechtig wordent vnd
habin yn gekorn der sich dieser stucke vndirwinde. Vnd wen sie
alsus kiesent, der sal die selbin macht han die der vorgenante gref
von Wertheim gehabit hat, als da vor begriffen ist.
Were ouch daz der landesherren deheiner were der vor den
drien nicht recht tûn enwolde vmb soliche stucke als da vor ge-
rurt ist, den sollen wir dar zû halten daz er yme vor vns vnd
vnsern mannen an rechte begnongen laze. Vnd enwolte er des nit
tûn, so sollen wir dem vorgenanten bischof von Wirtzeburg
wider yn beholfin sin, vnd yn helfen rechtfertigen als ouch da vor
geschriebin ist.
Alle diese vorgeschriebin stucke vnd artikel vnd yrn ieglichen
besundern han wir bede vnser einer dem andern in gûten truwen
globt vnd zû den heilgen gesworn stete vnd veste zû haltene, vz-
gescheiden alle argelist vnd geverde.
Vnd des zû vrkunde ist vnser jngesiegel gehangen an die-
sen brief.
Der gebin ist in dem Spechtisharte bi dem Rorbrûnnen,
do man zalte nach Cristus geburte drutzehenhundert jar dar nah in
dem nune vnd drizegesten jare, des fritages nah sante Johans tag
den man nennet ante portam latinam.
entries.english:
We, Heinrich, by the grace of God archbishop of the holy see of Mainz, archchancellor of the Holy Roman Empire in the German lands, make known to all people and declare openly with this letter that, because of the need of ourselves, our diocese and the land, we have unanimously agreed for the common good and have allied ourselves and ally ourselves with this letter with the venerable lord Lord Otto, bishop of Würzburg, and he with us, for the four years next coming which now begin, as follows, written word for word.
First, we shall help him against anyone who would use force or wrong against him, his diocese or his subjects.
And if it happens that he summons us for help in need, we shall help him, according to how he summons us or our Vitztum at Aschaffenburg, within fourteen days of the summons, to a daily war with fifty men well equipped with helmets, at his cost and our harm and loss. But if the need arises and he summons us as written above, we shall help him with our power without fraud, at his cost and our harm and loss as written above.
And if the people of us both take booty together by capture, the booty shall be divided according to the number of men each of us had there at the time. Ransoms we shall divide equally. All cattle, except horses, shall go to him towards the cost. If we or our household, without his people, take booty in the war by captured horses or riding goods, this shall be ours alone.
If we win castles or fortresses in the war, together or separately, which held in fief from him or from us, they shall belong under us to the one from whom they held in fief. If they did not hold from our domain, we shall break them or otherwise do with them as we both then agree.
For siege engines and other works which we need for it, we shall bear the cost jointly without fraud.
From this alliance we except the see of Rome and the Roman Empire. Further we except all our suffragans, our men, castle-men, ministeriales and citizens, and all those with whom we were allied before, to their rights.
If we cannot give him lawful help within one month after he brought it to us against those whom we have excepted, we shall within fourteen days thereafter, if we or our officials are summoned, help against the one who denies him justice in the same way as against anyone else, as written above.
And so that all these allied pieces and articles, as they are written here before and after, may be kept firmly and steadily by each of us, and complete love and friendship between us and our people may remain, and all disputes, events and discords which might arise may be restrained and settled, we have chosen as counselors the stern knight Eberhard von Rosenberg, our Vogt at Dürn or whoever is our official at Dürn at the time, for us, and the aforesaid lord of Würzburg Konrad Jemerer, knight, his official at Hohenburg or whoever is official at Hohenburg at the time, for himself; and we both together have chosen the noble man Rodolph, count of Wertheim, as a common arbiter, so that whichever of us or our people for whom we both are responsible suffers any encroachment or harm may immediately bring it before both our aforesaid counselors, and the same counselors shall within eight days after the complaint is brought to them ride into the town of Wertheim, and never leave until they have ended the complaints, either amicably with the knowledge and will of both parties, or by law without their knowledge and will. And whatever they thus unanimously rule and pronounce as right upon their oath, and give in writing with their open sealed letters, the parties shall keep on both sides. If they should disagree on the law, each of them shall give his opinion in writing with his open sealed letters to the count of Wertheim. And whoever thus gives his opinion in writing may then ride away. And whatever the count of Wertheim then pronounces on it, and whichever opinion he supports and also gives his letters about, that shall have force and shall be kept. And the aforesaid officials of us both have promised this and sworn on the saints, and those who become officials after them shall also promise and swear it, whenever complaints are brought to them, to ride to Wertheim and to settle the complaints one after another as they are brought to them, without any fraud, as written before and after.
If the aforesaid count of Wertheim should die or be unable to be present for these matters, the aforesaid counselors, when summoned by us or one of us, shall immediately ride to Wertheim, or if they are already there remain there, and never leave until they have agreed without fraud on another arbiter satisfactory to us both and have chosen him to undertake these matters. And whomever they thus choose shall have the same power which the aforesaid count of Wertheim had, as set out above.
If any of the lords of the land should refuse to do right by the three [of them] concerning such matters as are touched on above, we shall hold him to it that he gives satisfaction before us and our men at law. And if he would not do so, we shall help the aforesaid bishop of Würzburg against him and help him to enforce justice, as also written above.
All these written pieces and articles, and each of them individually, we both, each to the other, have promised in good faith and sworn on the saints to keep firmly and steadily, all guile and fraud excepted.
And in witness hereof our seal is hung on this letter.
Given in the Spechtshart near Rohrbrunn, when one counted after Christ's birth thirteen hundred years thereafter in the thirty-ninth year, on the Friday after the day of St. John, which is called ante portam latinam.

facts.content: allied himself for four years with Bishop Otto of Würzburg in a mutual defensive alliance.
allied himself for four years with Archbishop Heinrich of Mainz in a mutual defensive alliance.
was chosen as counselor for the archbishop of Mainz to settle disputes under the alliance.
was chosen as counselor for the bishop of Würzburg to settle disputes under the alliance.
was chosen as common arbiter of the alliance, with seat at Wertheim.
